44/G.goal: Describe the self-report questionnaires and the implemented Majuli VR Tour demos that form the basis for evaluating an XR system.
44/G.achieves: It supports the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system with confidence by connecting implementation with user evaluation in a concrete case study.

44/O1.goal: Explain how self-report questionnaires support user evaluation in XR, including standard instruments for post-task usability, post-session usability, and cybersickness.
44/O1.achieves: It gives the learner the instruments and interpretation criteria needed to collect and understand user feedback on an XR system.

44/O2.goal: Summarize the Majuli VR Tour implementation, size optimizations, and user experience flows of its three demo implementations.
44/O2.achieves: It helps the learner see how an XR system design becomes a working case-study application and what users can do in it.
